source: scripts/build_estimate_ledger.py over data/player_projections.json (shipped + candidate) and data/player_weekly.json (weekly split); kickoffs from data/schedule_full.json
note: per player: first as-of, latest as-of, and `locked` = the per-week estimate frozen at the last as-of before that week's first kickoff (the row the resolver scores). A week's estimate = season estimate x weeks[w]/sum(weeks).
